name: Tasogare no Elesia ~Divus Rabies 0~
original_name: 黄昏のエレジーア～Divus Rabies 0～
source:
Michael is a genius sorcerer. His ambition is to conquer the world...

One day, Michael and his troops start invading the kingdom of Diastan with Michael's motto, "Everything in this world is pleasure and game."

As he gets to know what's going on in Diastan, he finds the fact that there is a mystery in the kingdom...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
迈克尔是一名天才魔法师，他的野心是征服世界……

某天，迈克尔以“世间万物皆为享乐与游戏”为信条，率领军队开始入侵迪亚斯坦王国。

随着逐渐了解迪亚斯坦的局势，他发现这个王国隐藏着一个谜团……

[摘自ErogeShop]
